target_kind: same frozen ordinary public subgroup point as Q1301, Q1448, Q1451, and Q1452

point_decomposition.table_schedule: shuffle all 0<=i<=j<K orbit-pair blocks with frozen seed, then 53 relative Frobenius shifts and plus/minus signs per block; compare pair-attempt prefixes at three caps
point_decomposition.table_collision_policy: retain every descriptor at a signed-Frobenius key with its pair-attempt ordinal; one query schedule is checked against each prefix
point_decomposition.query_stop: process entire frozen query cap unless 1200-second external wall cap is reached

rank_accounting.columns: 227 folded factor-base orbit logs plus one public-target log column
rank_accounting.row: four point-log coefficients and target coefficient minus one modulo r
rank_accounting.novelty: incremental exact Gaussian rank over prime subgroup modulus, separately for each table prefix
